Hi Kkb:)

I like your chart, clearly shows history of the price. Big plus. However I rarely take a trade only because of good history or even fresh zone. Engulf marked as A on your chart was important but this trade was planned as short-term because of bear momentum candle ( 1). After strong approach, rally slowed down and first buyer/profit taking came in ( 2). Bears weakened causing nice compression ( 3) This was attractive enough to take the trade. Trade was executed manually.
